candidates.change_summary: Remove the assignment to betLimit so that betLimit retains its old value after AdjustBetAmounts is called.
Replace the assignment to betLimit with a constant assignment to 0, so betLimit always becomes zero regardless of amount.
Replace the assignment with betLimit = amount + 1, making the stored limit always one more than the provided amount.
Delete the entire require statement in onlyOwner, removing the access control so anyone can call AdjustBetAmounts and change betLimit.
Replace require(msg.sender == owner) with require(true), effectively removing the owner check.
Remove the assignment to the state variable difficulty so AdjustDifficulty only emits the event without changing the value.
Replace the assignment with difficulty = amount + 1, so the stored value differs from the argument and from the original assignment.
Delete the require inside onlyOwner so that anyone can call AdjustDifficulty and change difficulty.
Change onlyOwner to require msg.sender != owner, inverting the access control so the real owner cannot call AdjustDifficulty.
Changed assignment from true to false, so OpenToThePublic() leaves openToPublic as false.
Removed the assignment statement so OpenToThePublic() never sets openToPublic to true.
Removed the onlyOwner modifier, allowing anyone to call OpenToThePublic().
Changed onlyOwner modifier to always pass, allowing anyone to call OpenToThePublic().
